description: Build the proxy username and URL for one connection: pool, country, rotation and an optional session name are encoded in the username (validated by the server: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country or "any", and the mobile pool only in US, GB, FR, NL, PL, GE = Georgia (country)). Returns host, port, username, the URL and curl / Python / Node / Playwright snippets. The password is masked unless reveal_password is true. A sticky session keeps the same device, and the carrier may still change its IP; never promise a fixed IP. Needs a traffic balance (buy_traffic first) and an API key with ports:write.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 (e.g. "GB") or "any"; see list_countries for what is online now

pool.description: mobile = 4G/5G carrier modems (US, GB, FR, NL, PL, GE = Georgia (country)); residential = opt-in peer devices in the countries list_countries reports online now; best = whichever is available

reveal_password.description: Default false: the URL comes back with the password masked. Set true only when the user needs the working URL.

rotation.description: auto5|auto10|auto20|auto60 = new IP every N minutes; ondemand = new IP on every connection; sticky = keep the same device for the session (the carrier may still change its IP)

session.description: Session name, a-z 0-9 _ only. Optional: a stable one is derived for sticky.

name: build_proxy_url
title: Build a proxy URL
